title: Epic: Remove gracy dependency and add adaptive backpressure
description:
## Requirements (IMMUTABLE)

- Remove the gracy dependency entirely from almapy
- Replace with composed AlmaClient owning: httpx.AsyncClient, TokenBucket, AdaptiveController, asyncio.Semaphore
- Use stamina for per-request retries with configurable attempts
- Implement AIMD adaptive backpressure: halve rate on server failure, additive +1 req/s recovery (time-gated, not per-request)
- Configurable max_wait timeout for backpressure (callers never see CircuitOpenError, only ThrottleTimeoutError if max_wait exceeded)
- All public namespace method signatures remain unchanged
- All existing exception types remain unchanged
- Box response wrapping remains unchanged
- Explicit client lifecycle: aclose(), __aenter__/__aexit__, optional httpx.AsyncClient injection

## Success Criteria (MUST ALL BE TRUE)

- [ ] Zero imports from gracy anywhere in src/ or tests/
- [ ] gracy removed from pyproject.toml dependencies
- [ ] stamina added as dependency
- [ ] All namespace methods preserve their current signatures and return types
- [ ] TokenBucket, AdaptiveController have comprehensive unit tests
- [ ] AlmaEndpoint.build() has unit tests and strict validation (missing + extra keys rejected)
- [ ] _validate_response() and _should_retry() have unit tests
- [ ] mypy passes with strict mode
- [ ] ruff passes
- [ ] AlmaClient supports async context manager protocol
- [ ] AlmaClient accepts optional httpx.AsyncClient injection
- [ ] Adaptive backpressure: rate halves on APIServerError/ThrottleError, recovers +1 req/s per recovery_window
- [ ] Recovery is time-gated (not per-request)
- [ ] Cooldown suppresses both failure and success rate adjustments
- [ ] max_wait=None means unlimited wait (asyncio.timeout(None) is no-op)

## Anti-Patterns (FORBIDDEN)

- NO lazy imports to avoid circular deps (use TYPE_CHECKING + string annotations instead)
- NO from __future__ import annotations (use string annotations "AlmaClient" directly)
- NO per-request recovery ("+5% per success" causes explosive recovery under concurrency - use time-gated additive increase)
- NO CircuitOpenError raised to callers (backpressure is internal; only ThrottleTimeoutError if max_wait exceeded)
- NO mutable defaults in function signatures (use None, not {})
- NO logging side effects (no logging.getLogger(...).propagate = False at import time)
- NO changing the constructor param name from apikey to api_key (preserve current interface)
- NO AlmaLocation enum (location stays Literal[str])
- NO Box removal (deferred to Pydantic integration epic)
- NO structlog auto-detection (defer custom logging until there are enough events)

## Approach

Replace Gracy inheritance with composed AlmaClient. Three separated resilience concerns: asyncio.Semaphore (concurrency cap), TokenBucket (rate limiting with mutable rate), AdaptiveController (AIMD backpressure adjusting TokenBucket rate). stamina retry_context for per-request retries. BaseNamespace replaces GracyNamespace with parser parameter for XML/204/JSON response types. All changes in one branch.

## Architecture

AlmaClient (composed, no base class)
  httpx.AsyncClient - HTTP transport
  TokenBucket - async token bucket, mutable rate
  AdaptiveController - AIMD: halve on fail, +1/recovery_window on success
  asyncio.Semaphore - hard concurrency cap
  Namespaces (BaseNamespace subclasses)
    users, bibs, acq, config, analytics

Execution pipeline:
  semaphore -> controller.acquire() -> [stamina retry: http + validate + parse] -> record success/failure

title: Task 1: Create _throttle.py - TokenBucket + AdaptiveController
description:
## Goal

Create src/almapy/_throttle.py with TokenBucket (async token bucket, mutable rate) and AdaptiveController (AIMD backpressure). Create tests/test_throttle.py with comprehensive unit tests. Add ThrottleTimeoutError to exceptions.py.

## Implementation

### Step 1: Add ThrottleTimeoutError to exceptions.py

File: src/almapy/exceptions.py
Add at end of file:

class ThrottleTimeoutError(TimeoutError):
    """Raised when max_wait is exceeded waiting for adaptive throttle."""

### Step 2: Write failing tests for TokenBucket

File: tests/test_throttle.py

Test cases:
- test_token_bucket_rejects_zero_rate: TokenBucket(0) raises ValueError
- test_token_bucket_rejects_negative_rate: TokenBucket(-1) raises ValueError
- test_token_bucket_acquire_immediate: At rate=10, first acquire() returns without meaningful delay
- test_token_bucket_rate_property: rate getter/setter works, setter rejects non-positive
- test_token_bucket_rate_setter_caps_tokens: If rate lowered, existing tokens capped at new rate
- test_token_bucket_acquire_waits: At rate=2, 3 rapid acquires - third must wait ~0.5s (with tolerance)
- test_token_bucket_concurrent_acquire: Multiple concurrent acquires don't overdraw tokens

Run: uv run pytest tests/test_throttle.py -v
Expected: All fail with ImportError (module doesn't exist yet)

### Step 3: Implement TokenBucket

File: src/almapy/_throttle.py

class TokenBucket:
    __init__(self, rate: float) -> None  # validates rate > 0
    rate property (getter + setter, setter validates > 0, caps tokens)
    async acquire(self) -> None  # lock-protected refill + consume
    _refill(self) -> None  # tokens = min(rate, tokens + elapsed * rate)

Invariants:
  0 < rate
  0 <= _tokens <= rate
  _lock serialises refill + consume

Run: uv run pytest tests/test_throttle.py -v
Expected: TokenBucket tests pass

### Step 4: Write failing tests for AdaptiveController

Add to tests/test_throttle.py:

Test cases:
- test_adaptive_rejects_invalid_rates: min_rate > max_rate raises ValueError
- test_adaptive_record_failure_halves_rate: After record_failure(), bucket.rate == max_rate * 0.5
- test_adaptive_record_failure_respects_min_rate: Can't go below min_rate
- test_adaptive_cooldown_suppresses_failure: During cooldown, record_failure() is no-op
- test_adaptive_cooldown_suppresses_success: During cooldown, record_success() is no-op
- test_adaptive_recovery_is_time_gated: Two rapid record_success() calls - only first adjusts rate
- test_adaptive_recovery_adds_increment: After recovery_window, record_success() adds recovery_increment
- test_adaptive_recovery_capped_at_max: Can't exceed max_rate
- test_adaptive_acquire_waits_cooldown: After failure, acquire() blocks for cooldown duration
- test_adaptive_max_wait_raises: With max_wait=0.1 and long cooldown, acquire() raises TimeoutError
- test_adaptive_max_wait_none_unlimited: max_wait=None doesn't raise (asyncio.timeout(None) is no-op)
- test_adaptive_concurrent_failures_dont_compound: 10 concurrent failures - rate halves once, not 10 times

Run: uv run pytest tests/test_throttle.py -v
Expected: AdaptiveController tests fail (class doesn't exist yet)

### Step 5: Implement AdaptiveController

Add to src/almapy/_throttle.py:

class AdaptiveController:
    __init__(self, bucket, max_rate, *, backoff_factor=0.5, recovery_increment=1.0,
             recovery_window=10.0, cooldown=5.0, max_wait=None, min_rate=1.0)
    current_rate property -> float
    async acquire(self) -> None  # asyncio.timeout(max_wait), sleep cooldown, bucket.acquire()
    record_failure(self) -> None  # skip if cooling, halve rate, set cooldown
    record_success(self) -> None  # skip if cooling or at max or too soon, add increment

Run: uv run pytest tests/test_throttle.py -v
Expected: All tests pass

### Step 6: Type check and lint

Run:
  uv run mypy src/almapy/_throttle.py src/almapy/exceptions.py
  uv run ruff check src/almapy/_throttle.py tests/test_throttle.py

## Success Criteria

- [ ] TokenBucket: rate validation, acquire timing, mutable rate, concurrent safety
- [ ] AdaptiveController: AIMD behaviour, time-gated recovery, cooldown suppression, max_wait
- [ ] ThrottleTimeoutError in exceptions.py
- [ ] All tests pass
- [ ] mypy passes strict
- [ ] ruff passes

title: Task 4: Create _base.py - BaseNamespace with parser support
description:
## Goal
Create BaseNamespace to replace GracyNamespace. Owns URL building via endpoint.build(). Supports parser parameter for XML/204/JSON responses.

## Implementation
1. Create src/almapy/_base.py with BaseNamespace class
2. __init__(self, client: "AlmaClient") using TYPE_CHECKING + string annotation
3. _get, _post, _put, _delete methods accepting endpoint, path, parser, **kwargs
4. Each calls self._client._execute(method, endpoint.build(path), parser=parser, **kwargs)
5. path parameter: Mapping[str, str] | None = None (no mutable default)
6. mypy + ruff pass

## Success Criteria
- [ ] BaseNamespace created with _get/_post/_put/_delete
- [ ] URL building delegated to endpoint.build() inside base methods
- [ ] parser parameter supported for non-JSON responses
- [ ] No from __future__ import annotations
- [ ] mypy strict + ruff pass

title: Task 5: Rewrite _client.py - composed AlmaClient
description:
## Goal
Full rewrite of _client.py replacing Gracy base class with composed architecture.

## Implementation
1. Remove all gracy imports
2. AlmaClient as plain class (no base class)
3. Compose: httpx.AsyncClient, TokenBucket, AdaptiveController, asyncio.Semaphore
4. _execute() pipeline: semaphore -> controller.acquire() -> _raw_request() -> record success/failure
5. _raw_request() with stamina retry_context (instance-configurable attempts)
6. Parser parameter in _execute for non-JSON responses (parsing inside retry loop)
7. Lifecycle: aclose(), __aenter__/__aexit__, optional client: httpx.AsyncClient injection
8. Keep apikey (not api_key), location as Literal[str], rate_limit, concurrent_requests
9. Add: retry_attempts, backoff_factor, recovery_increment, recovery_window, cooldown, max_wait, client
10. Remove: replay, debug
11. Top-level imports for namespace classes (no lazy imports)
12. mypy + ruff pass

## Success Criteria
- [ ] No gracy imports in _client.py
- [ ] AlmaClient composes httpx + throttle + semaphore
- [ ] _execute pipeline correct with parser support
- [ ] stamina retry_context with instance-level attempts
- [ ] Lifecycle methods (aclose, context manager, client injection)
- [ ] Constructor preserves apikey, location params
- [ ] mypy strict + ruff pass

title: Task 6: Update all namespace files - mechanical migration
description:
## Goal
Replace GracyNamespace with BaseNamespace and @graceful with parser parameter across all 5 namespace files.

## Implementation
For each of _users.py, _bibs.py, _acq.py, _config.py, _analytics.py:
1. Replace gracy imports with: from almapy._base import BaseNamespace
2. Change base class: GracyNamespace[AlmaEndpoint] -> BaseNamespace
3. JSON methods: self.get[RESP_TYPE](...) -> self._get(...)
4. JSON methods: self.get(...) -> self._get(...) (same for post, put, delete)
5. @graceful(parser={"default": lambda r: r.text}) methods -> parser=lambda r: r.text
6. @graceful(parser={HTTPStatus.NO_CONTENT: ..., "default": ...}) methods -> parser=lambda r: r.status_code == HTTPStatus.NO_CONTENT
7. Remove all @graceful decorators
8. Sub-namespace wiring in __init__ unchanged
9. Public method signatures unchanged
10. mypy + ruff pass on all files

## Success Criteria
- [ ] No gracy imports in any namespace file
- [ ] All methods use _get/_post/_put/_delete from BaseNamespace
- [ ] All @graceful decorators removed, parser param used instead
- [ ] Public method signatures unchanged
- [ ] mypy strict + ruff pass
